name: Hin Kong / Highway 33 service zone
capture_notes: Primary target-side zone on Suwannason Road / Highway 33, supported by Hin Kong town, Huai Khamin locality, roadside food and retail activity, and through traffic. Nearby EV competition is material and must be checked before sizing.

name: Nong Khae industrial north zone
capture_notes: Secondary employment and industrial-service zone near the Nong Khae industrial area. Useful for corridor coverage but should not be treated as the same demand pool as Hin Kong town.
